reviews.title: The Excellent Alesis Quadraverb GT Guitar Effects Processor

pull.q: The Alesis Quadraverb GT stands out as a powerhouse among guitar signal processors, integrating all the digital effects of the classic Alesis Quadraverb with an advanced analogue guitar pre-amp section.

quotes.t: What truly sets the Alesis Quadraverb GT apart is its unmatched capability to fine-tune the harmonic structure of your guitar's tone.
The technology is a bit old — it's 16-bit digital of 20 years ago.
quotes.s: Teoteo, Audiofanzine (translated from French) · the honest caveat
